subject.title: Write tool lacks append mode — isolated cron sessions destroy shared files

question: Should OpenClaw accept `append?: boolean` on the existing `write` tool as the permanent append contract, or require a different model-facing append API before closing this issue?
rationale: The data-loss class is source-reproducible, but the remaining fix is a public tool-contract and product API choice rather than a purely internal bug patch.

options.title: Accept append on write
options.body: Land the open implementation after maintainer review, keeping overwrite as the default and using `append: true` for safe accumulation.

options.title: Choose a different append contract
options.body: Ask for a replacement shape such as `mode: "append"` or a dedicated append tool before merging any public API.

options.title: Defer code and document workarounds
options.body: Keep the issue open and rely on backup or shell-append workarounds, accepting that truncation risk remains for ordinary write calls.

recommendation.title: Accept append on write
recommendation.body: Land the open implementation after maintainer review, keeping overwrite as the default and using `append: true` for safe accumulation.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision affects the shared agent runtime write-tool contract and steipete is the strongest history signal for that surface.
